name: quadplan
description: Local-first planning team for pre-development proposals, tickets, and design review

scripts.test: node --test server/package-bin.test.js server/config.test.js server/planning-queue.test.js server/planning-loop.test.js server/planning-loop-pulse.test.js server/artifact-preview.test.js server/file-chat.test.js server/file-chat.loopguard.test.js server/file-chat.system-messages.test.js server/ac-restore.test.js server/migrate-ac.test.js server/pty-dispatcher.test.js server/__tests__/scrub-secrets.test.js server/bridges/bridges.test.js server/routes.seedWorkspace.test.js server/routes.planningProgress.test.js server/routes.parseActiveBatch.test.js server/routes.batchProgress.test.js
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags && VERSION=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && gh release create "v$VERSION" --generate-notes --latest && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --follow-tags && VERSION=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && gh release create "v$VERSION" --generate-notes --latest && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --follow-tags && VERSION=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && gh release create "v$VERSION" --generate-notes --latest && npm publish
